question: A crew is locating components before a repair on a residential street. Which component carries water from the distribution main to a single property?
correctAnswer: A service line running from the main to the building
explanation: The service line is the pipe that connects the distribution main to the plumbing of one property, while mains and hydrant laterals serve the wider network.
options: A gate valve installed on the transmission main line
A service line running from the main to the building
A fire hydrant lateral feeding the hydrant assembly
A trunk main moving water between pressure zones
optionA: A gate valve installed on the transmission main line
optionB: A service line running from the main to the building
optionC: A fire hydrant lateral feeding the hydrant assembly
optionD: A trunk main moving water between pressure zones

question: Which step protects a dry barrel hydrant from freeze damage after firefighting use in January?
correctAnswer: Confirm the barrel drains fully once the main valve closes
explanation: A dry barrel hydrant protects itself from freezing when the barrel empties through its drains after the main valve closes, so confirming full drainage is the protective step.
options: Leave the main valve cracked open through the winter months
Fill the empty barrel with antifreeze before capping it shut
Confirm the barrel drains fully once the main valve closes
Remove the operating nut until spring maintenance begins
optionA: Leave the main valve cracked open through the winter months
optionB: Fill the empty barrel with antifreeze before capping it shut
optionC: Confirm the barrel drains fully once the main valve closes
optionD: Remove the operating nut until spring maintenance begins

question: A unidirectional flushing crew works through a neighbourhood in sequence. Which order keeps dislodged material moving away from clean water?
correctAnswer: Start near the source and flush outward toward the ends

Start near the source and flush outward toward the ends

Start at the highest lots and flush toward lower streets

question: Which input most directly raises the water level in an elevated tank during overnight hours?
